Text: This is your home. Place cards on the tiles that connect to your home to GROW.
TO WIN: surround opponent’s home tile, or have more tiles on the board when the Draw pile runs out.
Every turn has 3 steps - DRAW, GROW and THROW. You start by drawing 1 card from the top of the Draw pile or the Throw pile.
Grow: drag one of your cards from your hand onto the board, or tap it to select and then place it on the board.
Throw: swipe up, drag it to the Throw pile, or double tap to throw a card. This ends your turn.
Tiles keep the rank of the card used. Higher ranks are harder to cut.
The Draw pile is empty: each tile is now 1 point, and the numbers on tiles don’t count.
They draw, grow and throw too.
You had more points – you won!
Strengthen: a stronger card can replace your own tile.
Cut: a higher card can take an opponent’s tile.
You had more points – you won!
Nothing can Grow on a rock.
A gold tile counts double, so it is worth two points.
Cut a tile to break the chain behind it.
Tiles cut off from their home disappear.

BLOOM: three cards with the same number, or three in order in one suit.
Bloom grows several tiles at once and does NOT cost your GROW turn.

Surround: fill every tile around their home for an instant win.
Bomb: removes one enemy tile, even a 9. Uses your Grow.

Blast: two Bombs clear a large area. Homes are safe.
A Blast is an extra move: you can still Grow afterwards.
